capabilities: solve GMPL/MathProg linear models written in fenced code blocks
report objective value, variable values, statuses, constraint activity, and slack
plot theme-aware feasible regions for two-variable models
show precise parse errors for unsupported GMPL syntax
disambiguation: Not a general math or equation solver; it optimizes scalar GMPL linear programs and does not support indexed sets, summations, or nonlinear terms.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents the supported GMPL subset in detail and states that indexed sets, parameters, summations, conditional expressions, and nonlinear terms are intentionally unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to solve linear programs written inside notes; users must copy models to external solvers.
summary: Linear programming solver that evaluates GMPL/MathProg models in fenced code blocks and shows solutions plus feasible-region plots in Reading view.
